conceptual_algebra.definitions: Let a_r and b_r be product-query/history gradients aggregated at shared row r, v_r=a_r+b_r, and U_r all unchanged embedding paths.
conceptual_algebra.project: On eligible negative-inner-product rows, symmetric removal corresponds conceptually to a'_r=a_r-(a_r·b_r)/||b_r||² b_r and b'_r=b_r-(a_r·b_r)/||a_r||² a_r; use t_r=a'_r+b'_r. Other rows remain as declared.
conceptual_algebra.norm_control: Use n_r=(||t_r||/||v_r||)v_r on valid matching rows, subject to actual source safeguards. Matching ||n_r|| and ||t_r|| concerns this subcomponent only.
conceptual_algebra.total: New total embedding gradient is U_r+t_r or U_r+n_r. Equal subcomponent norms generally do not imply equal total norms or equal Adam updates.
conceptual_algebra.loss: Receipt describes a detached correction yielding unchanged scalar mean BCE but changed gradient. It is a deliberate surrogate training rule, not proof that the same numerical forward loss has a different ordinary derivative.
